info.title: SemIndex
info.description: The farm's semantic-index writer. Builds semantic-vectors.json for every site of the farm in a worker thread, so a wiki gets federated semantic search with no external service. wiki-plugin-similarity is the matching reader. These routes are served by this plugin's own server and are described here, not mounted by the farm — every one of them needs something a plain handler cannot have: the caller's identity, their address, or a status code that carries meaning.

get.description: Build state, queue, and the embedder's health. Polled by the SemIndex item to show progress. Read-only and ungated.

200.description: Current state of this farm's indexer.

get.description: Enqueues builds for the matching domains. Owner or admin only. Also accepts POST, which is the form the old FastAPI indexer used, so a remote similarity plugin can point WIKI_INDEXER_URL here unchanged.

parameters.name: domains
parameters.description: Comma-separated globs naming which sites to index.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Rebuild even where the index looks current.

200.description: What was queued, and the state afterwards.

403.description: Not the owner or an admin. Under the default read-only security module this is everybody, which makes build triggers inert on an unowned wiki — correct, because there the background scan does the indexing.

409.description: This farm is not running as a writer, so it will not build. One writer per synced farm.

post.description: The same operation as the GET, taking domains and force in a JSON body instead.

200.description: What was queued, and the state afterwards.

403.description: Not the owner or an admin.

409.description: This farm is not running as a writer.

get.summary: Turn one text into a vector
get.description: Embeds a single string with the farm's own model, so a slim remote similarity can point WIKI_EMBED_URL here. Rate-limited per caller address — thirty at once, refilling one a second — which is why it cannot be a farm-mounted operation: a handler never sees who is asking.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Accepted as an alias for text.

200.description: The vector, and which model made it.

429.description: Too many embeddings from this address just now.

mode.description: Only a writer builds. One writer per synced farm.

state.description: idle, or what it is doing now.

building.description: The domain being indexed, if any.

lastBuild.description: Per domain: when it last built, how many pages, how many embedded, how long it took.

Embedder.description: The model is run in a child process on purpose, so a crash in it costs an embedding rather than the wiki.

download.description: Progress, while the model is being fetched.

breakerOpenUntil.description: While set, embedding is refused until the crashes stop.
